prompt:
Use the attached image as the exact art direction reference. Reproduce it exactly:
a neon-lit arena at full tilt: banks of cyan, magenta and violet spotlight beams cutting down through the air from an overhead lighting truss, a packed crowd glowing in the tiered stands under the colour wash, LED ribbon boards running around the bowl, and a dark wooden arena floor drenched in violet and cyan light. High-energy, saturated, electric.

Change TWO things, and nothing else:

1. REMOVE every sport marking from the floor. No court lines, no painted key, no
   three-point arc, no centre circle, no boundary tape — nothing.
   The floor becomes the dark wooden arena floor drenched in violet and cyan light, completely clean and unmarked, its reflections and
   material exactly as in the reference.

2. REMOVE every piece of sports equipment from the venue — basketball hoops and
   backboards, goals, nets, posts, benches, apparatus, scoreboards. Whatever the
   equipment was standing in front of (seating, wall, structure) is revealed behind it,
   continuing naturally. The playing area is left completely bare.

Everything else is identical: same structures, same materials, same lighting
direction, same camera height and perspective, same colour grade, same composition.

Hard requirements:
- Vertical poster format, 2:3.
- Completely empty stage. No people, no props, no sports equipment of any kind.
- No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks.
- Photorealistic, sharp, print quality.
